description: Upcoming matches in Ugandan sport (no result yet), nearest first: Uganda Premier League, national teams, women's and youth football, rugby, netball, basketball, volleyball and more, from official federation fixture lists. Each match has competition, teams, date and kickoff in East Africa Time (EAT, UTC+3) and UTC, venue and a link to its match page. "Uganda" also covers beach soccer, U-17 and women's teams, so always read the competition field.

competition.description: Competition contains this text, e.g. "Uganda Premier League", "AFCON"

from.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD (EAT). Fixtures default: today

team.description: Only matches of this team, e.g. "Vipers" or "SC Villa"

to.description: Last date, YYYY-MM-DD (EAT). Results default: today

name: get_fixtures
title: Upcoming fixtures
